newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar holds gains in heavy session.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar holds gains in heavy session.

text.p: Nearby white sugar futures retained most of their earlier gains on Thursday afternoon as players crossed their way out of the spot May contract and equivalent raws positions stayed firm.

Earlier, trade buying of the May/August spread and also the outright position pushed May through initial resistance at $312.50 and up to a high of $313.20 where more trade buying interest was noted in the afternoon.
May/August narrowed back to around $1.50 after reaching a peak of $3.50 earlier this week, with the overall volume boosted by commission house crosses and broker buying at the lows.

The spread has been relatively active in recent days given the pre-expiry trading. May expires on April 15. Mixed broker selling of the October contract, along with other crossed AA trades, were also mentioned.
At 1625 GMT May was up 50 cents at its session high of $313.20 and August was up $1.10 at $311.80.
Market volume amounted to a hefty 5,062 lots on account of the AA and crossed trades.
Technical analysts pegged May's next resistance points at $315 followed by $318.
Only the two front months were traded on the Paris market where volume reached 790 lots. May was up $1.40 at $314.00 and August up by the same amount at $3111.40.
